newsitem.title: USA: Equity Inns to buy 8 hotels for $52.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Equity Inns to buy 8 hotels for $52.5 mln.

text.p: Equity Inns Inc said on Tuesday it signed agreements to buy eight hotels with a total 839 rooms for $52.5 million in cash and operating partnership units.
The sales were expected to close in early 1997, the company said.
The eight hotels were four Residence Inns in Oklahoma, Colorado, Arizona and Wisconsin and four Hampton Inns in Tennessee, Georgia, Virginia and Mississippi, it said.

"We continue to see opportunities to acquire quality hotels and portfolios throughout the United States, both through our alliance with Promus Hotel Corp and Interstate Hotels Co, and on our own," Chairman Phillip McNeill Sr. said. He said the company was back on track for its acquisition plan, after a delay in the third quarter.
